name: The Bellows
blurb: A forgeborn made into a bellows, Act Two's Ironspire: a swollen body of dark puffed leather strapped crosswise with brass-buckled belts, a round brass furnace grate burning in its chest, a brass-framed vent on its shoulder, glowing slits torn in the leather all over, a chimney of a hood for a head with a brass lantern cap, and a brass pipe curling up from its shoulder into the cap. Every part moves whole on its own joint, so nothing stretches.
